definition: The Innovation Park Artificial Intelligence (IPAI) is an AI-focused innovation platform and planned research and development campus in Heilbronn, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.
details: It brings together actors from business, science and the public sector to develop and test applications of artificial intelligence (AI). The project originated in the state’s competition to host an “AI Innovation Park” and has been supported by the Dieter Schwarz Foundation, the Schwarz Group and the City of Heilbronn. The CEO of IPAI is Moritz Gräter.
